title: Mother & Lois Outdoor Portrait, 1940 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A 1940 black and white full-length snapshot capturing two women, identified on the back as Mother and Lois, standing together outdoors in a sunny yard. The younger woman on the left wears a structured 1940s dark skirt suit with broad shoulders, while the older woman on the right wears a floral print day dress with buttons and eyeglasses. The background reveals a rural setting with a wooden post fence, outbuildings, and a rotary clothes dryer under bright sunlight.
